title: File:Circ de Colomèrs des de Bergús.jpg
claims: The photograph is a clear-summer view into the Colomèrs cirque: several dark blue lakes, granite slabs, scree fields, residual snow patches and bare rocky ridges, with more distant Pyrenean ridges on the horizon.

Commons titles the photograph Circ de Colomèrs des de Bergús.jpg and its description names Estanys de Cap de Colomèrs, Ratera de Colomèrs and Estany Obago; it shows the high-mountain environment, not the VDA aid station, course marking, timing mat, start arch, finish line or race-day runner.
The author is Contraix; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2013-08-15 at 13:20:04; the original is 5,184 x 2,915 pixels and 3,760,048 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 540 copy of 191,521 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Contraix, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
